fidelity.scope: Local experience-fidelity refinement; accepted identity preserved
fidelity.behavior: The opening now offers an opt-in three-shot sequence: establish the scene, inspect circuitry, leave good notes. Original posters—not source footage—are recomposed with a750ms rectangular shutter and4200ms shot-specific camera travel. Caption, Previous/Next, play/pause and interruptible reversal operate on phones as well as desktop. Playback never starts automatically and has no audio. It pauses offscreen/hidden; reduced motion disables playback while manual selection changes image/caption immediately. Separate portrait opening remains, detailed/notes shots have deliberate phone crops.

narrative.overview: A personal image essay carried by authored technology still-lifes. The interface recedes around large material-rich images, then becomes a spacious silver-white reading surface. Source inspiration is cinematic image scale and sparse contact-sheet structure, not agency identity or a project catalogue.
keyCharacteristics: Large grotesk type and restrained readable navigation.
Ordinary document reading, no scenic operation required.
Silver-white editorial pacing and ruled contact rows.

rules.name: The Image Owns Color Rule
rules.body: Rendered objects supply green circuitry and brushed silver. Do not repeat those colors as badges, buttons or box fills.

rules.name: The Two Distances Rule
rules.body: Display is seen across the frame; prose is read at arm's length. Never shrink prose to preserve a one-screen composition.

dos: Do keep substantive paragraphs at 17–18px in normal document scroll.
Do preserve image detail, clear captions and light/dark pacing.
Do label original synthetic scenes honestly.
donts: Don't invent projects, clients, outcomes or equipment ownership.
Don't use source films, logos, office addresses or VFX claims.
Don't turn the reading into a grid of equal cards.
